arxiv-1908-10812.title: Performance study of a Time of Flight Method used for cosmic ray detection
arxiv-1908-10812.creator: ALİ YILMAZ
arxiv-1908-10812.description: Abstract Time of Flight methods have been rapidly developed and used in many experiments recently for determination of particle direction, identification of particles and energy resolutions. This paper describes a method of time-mark determination on the reconstruction algorithm, based on the sampled signal, used for time-of-flight measurements.

arxiv-2111-15441.title: Decoding the conductance of disordered nanostructures: a quantum inverse problem
arxiv-2111-15441.creator: S. Mukim, J. O’Brien, M. Abarashi, M. S. Ferreira, C. G. Rocha
arxiv-2111-15441.description: Abstract Obtaining conductance spectra for a concentration of disordered impurities distributed over a nanoscale device with sensing capabilities is a well-defined problem. However, to do this inversely, i.e., extracting information about the scatters from the conductance spectrum alone, is not an easy task. In the presence of impurities, even advanced techniques of inversion can become particularly challenging.

arxiv-2112-10210.title: Exact matrix product state representation and convergence of a fully correlated electronic wavefunction in the infinite basis limit
arxiv-2112-10210.creator: Gero Friesecke, Benedikt R. Graswald, Örs Legeza
arxiv-2112-10210.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gero Friesecke, Benedikt R. Graswald, Örs Legeza. In this article we present the exact representation of a fully correlated electronic wavefunction as the single-particle basis approaches completeness. It consists of a half-infinite chain of matrices of exponentially increasing size. The complete basis limit is illustrated numerically using the density matrix renormalization group method by computing the core-valence entanglement in the C 2 ground state in increasing subsets of cc-pVTZ and pVQZ bases until convergence is reached.

arxiv-2204-07821.title: Detection of Small Holes by the Scale-Invariant Robust Density-Aware Distance (RDAD) Filtration
arxiv-2204-07821.creator: Chunyin (Alex) Siu, Gennady Samorodnitsky, Christina Lee Yu, Andrey Yao
arxiv-2204-07821.description: Abstract A novel topological-data-analytical (TDA) method is proposed to distinguish, from noise, small holes surrounded by high-density regions of a probability density function. The proposed method is robust against additive noise and outliers. Traditional TDA tools, like those based on the distance filtration, often struggle to distinguish small features from noise, because both have short persistences.

arxiv-2206-07867.title: A visual introduction to information theory
arxiv-2206-07867.creator: Henry Pinkard, Laura Waller
arxiv-2206-07867.description: Abstract \vskip-26.0pt Though originally developed for communications engineering, information theory contains mathematical tools with numerous applications in science and engineering. These tools can be used to characterize the fundamental limits of data compression and transmission in the presence of noise.

arxiv-2510-09210.title: Provable Watermarking for Data Poisoning Attacks
arxiv-2510-09210.creator: Yifan Zhu, Lijia Yu, Xiao-Shan Gao
arxiv-2510-09210.description: Abstract In recent years, data poisoning attacks have been increasingly designed to appear harmless and even beneficial, often with the intention of verifying dataset ownership or safeguarding private data from unauthorized use. However, these developments have the potential to cause misunderstandings and conflicts, as data poisoning has traditionally been regarded as a security threat to machine learning systems.

arxiv-2510-19677.title: Multi-photon ring structure of reflection-asymmetric traversable thin-shell wormholes
arxiv-2510-19677.creator: Caio F. B. Macedo, João Luís Rosa, Diego Rubiera-Garcia, Alejandro Rueda
arxiv-2510-19677.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Caio F. B. Macedo, João Luís Rosa, Diego Rubiera-Garcia, Alejandro Rueda. We consider the observational signatures of thin accretion disks around a reflection-asymmetric traversable thin-shell wormhole. This wormhole, built in the framework of Palatini f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity coupled to a Maxwell field using a junction conditions formalism, lacks horizons but features photon spheres on each side of the throat, described by different effective potentials and at different locations.

pmc-12528379.creator: Xiaolan Chen, Jin You, Qin Ma, Jiamei Lin, Yu Ji, Shi Li, Zhenxing Song, Rui Su, Ge Shan, Chuan Huang
pmc-12528379.description: R-loop is a common chromatin feature consisting of a displaced single-stranded DNA and an RNA-DNA hybrid, and dysregulation of R-loop surveillance results in genomic and transcriptomic instability. Although the RNA moiety of most R-loops originates from linear transcripts, circular RNAs (circRNAs), outputs from back-splicing, can also hybridize with the complementary strand of a DNA duplex.

pmc-12729208.title: Association between the null polymorphisms of GSTT1 and GSTM1 and the risk of gestational diabetes mellitus: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12729208.creator: Zitong Liu, Chenxi Ji, Rui Wang, Qiyue Liu, Xiaoyin Guo, Li Fan, Youyi Kong, Lingxi Chen, Xiaoqin Yang, Shangshang Gao
pmc-12729208.description: BackgroundThe relationship between the null polymorphisms of the GSTT1 and GSTM1 genes and the risk of gestational diabetes mellitus has been previously investigated. However, these scattered evidence remained controversial. Therefore, this systematic review and meta-analysis was performed to synthesize previous findings and statistically estimate whether these polymorphic variants are associated with the risk of this common pregnancy complication.

pmc-13117255.title: Percutaneous Transhepatic Endobiliary Microwave Ablation Before Stenting for Malignant Obstructive Jaundice: Evidence Synthesis and Preliminary Technical Experience
pmc-13117255.creator: Adam Hatzidakis, Nikolas Matthaiou, Leonidas Kougias, Georgios Papadopoulos, Alexandros Mekras, Dimitrios Tsavdaris, Eleni Karlafti, Daniel Paramythiotis
pmc-13117255.description: Malignant biliary obstruction is commonly treated with biliary stenting either endoscopically or percutaneously; however, tumor ingrowth might occlude the stent, often leading to recurrent jaundice and repeat interventions. Endobiliary microwave ablation (MWA) is an emerging adjunct intended to devitalize intraductal tumors and potentially prolong stent patency.

pmc-13146060.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026YS251 IMPACT OF ANTERIOR CIRCULATION ARTERIAL BRANCHING VARIATIONS ON ISCHAEMIC STROKE TERRITORIES AND CLINICAL ASSESSMENT: A SYSTEMATIC INTEGRATION AND RETROSPECTIVE COHORT STUDY PROTOCOL
pmc-13146060.creator: Sebastião Branca, Trevor Decker, Edson de Oliveira, Juan Tejada
pmc-13146060.description: Background and aimsThe Circle of Willis exhibits significant anatomical variations in most individuals. As ischaemic stroke predominantly affects the anterior circulation, understanding variations in the anterior cerebral artery (ACA) and middle cerebral artery (MCA) is crucial. These anomalies alter territorial supply, potentially complicating CT angiography (CTA) interpretation and the assessment of atypical stroke patterns.MethodsThis research project employs a two-stage design.

pmc-13359556.title: Immunometabolic reprogramming and mitochondrial dysfunction in acute respiratory distress syndrome: mechanisms, metabolic resilience, and therapeutic perspectives- a narrative review
pmc-13359556.creator: Thejesh Srinivas, Gagana Hanumaiah, Danavath Nagendra, Shwethapriya R., Souvik Chaudhuri, Vinutha R. Bhat, Shobha U. Kamath
pmc-13359556.description: BackgroundAcute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is a biologically heterogeneous condition in which patients exposed to similar injurious stimuli often develop markedly different clinical trajectories and outcomes. While inflammation is central to ARDS pathogenesis, inflammatory burden alone does not fully explain the variability in disease progression, treatment response, or recovery.

pmc-13505119.title: CD4+T cells mediate systemic and local immune changes and pain symptoms in the rat model of temporomandibular disorders related pain
pmc-13505119.creator: Jianquan He, Yuzhuo Hei, Lin Li, Xiaojun Xia, Zhihui Mai, Xiayun Chen
pmc-13505119.description: Background and purposeImmune cells involved in pain has received increasing attention, but the available literature on the role of T cells in temporomandibular disorders (TMD) related pain is limited. Our previous study has showed that elevated expression of HLA DR+ CD4+ T cell may increase the risk of TMD-related pain.

pmc-13548259.title: Clinical outcomes and economic burden of bacterial meningitis in Africa: a protocol for systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13548259.creator: Bezie Kebede, Bereket Bahiru Tefera, Bezuayehu Alemayehu
pmc-13548259.description: AbstractIntroductionBacterial meningitis remains a significant global public health concern and poses a substantial burden in Africa, including clinical and associated economic burden. This review aims to evaluate clinical outcomes and summarise the economic burden of bacterial meningitis across African countries.Methods and analysisThis review will follow the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses checklist.

pmc-13619780.title: Post Hoc Analysis of Solriamfetol Efficacy in Obstructive Sleep Apnea Patients with Excessive Daytime Sleepiness Stratified by Disease Severity
pmc-13619780.creator: Changjun Su, Jiucheng Shen, Kaida Guo, Jing Wang, Zhijun Wang, Shiyuan Gao, Qiaojun Wang, Fei Han, Weijia Zhang, Hui Ye, Xiang Li, Ruolin Zhang, Rui Chen
pmc-13619780.description: IntroductionSolriamfetol, a dopamine and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor, is indicated for the treatment of excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS) associated with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).
